headline: Local Diplomatic Liaison Mistakenly Sends BRICS Invite To A Neighborhood Tea Stall Instead Of Iran
body:
A junior official at the External Affairs Ministry is currently scrambling to rectify a catastrophic administrative error after sending a high-level BRICS summit participation invite to a roadside chai point in South Delhi instead of the Iranian delegation. The mix-up occurred when the aide, exhausted after a 16-hour shift, accidentally autocompleted the 'I.R.I' field in the secure server using a contact saved as 'Irani-Chai-Wala-Bhai'.

“The confusion was total because the shop owner, Mr. Gupta, actually responded with a very diplomatic confirmation,” said a senior ministry clerk. “He told our protocol team that he is more than happy to bring his signature clay cups to the summit, provided we cover the round-trip fare for his portable gas stove and ensure the venue has enough space for a folding bench. He even offered to bring his own biscuits to keep the geopolitical tension light.”

Observers note that the tea stall has effectively replaced the Islamic Republic on several internal tracking spreadsheets, with analysts now debating if a perfectly brewed masala chai might actually serve as a more stable diplomatic bridge than the original itinerary. As of this morning, the Ministry has decided to keep the invitation active, claiming that adding a 'third-party tea consultant' to the summit might be exactly the unconventional tightrope act required to balance the various international interests at play.
caption: When you accidentally hit 'reply all' on a geopolitical summit invite. Diplomacy is all about the blend. ☕️🇮🇳 #BRICS #DiplomacyFail #ChaiDiplomacy #Geopolitics (satire)
igHook: Would you trust a local tea vendor to handle international trade negotiations instead of a diplomat?
imagePrompt: A close-up, slightly out-of-focus shot of a steaming clay cup of tea resting on a weathered wooden table in an urban street setting.
